mapper.sql: s.id as skillId,s.account_id as accountId,s.visibility,s.name,s.description, s.status,s.current_version_id as currentVersionId,s.revision,s.created_at as createdAt,s.updated_at as updatedAt

v.id as versionId,v.account_id as accountId,v.skill_id as skillId, v.version_no as versionNo,v.skill_type as skillType,v.tool_name as toolName, v.instructions,v.context_requirements as contextRequirements,v.tool_url as toolUrl, v.http_method as httpMethod,v.input_schema as inputSchema,v.output_schema as outputSchema, v.tool_secret_id as toolSecretId,v.requires_user_credential as requiresUserCredential, v.identity_binding as identityBinding,v.frontend_fields as frontendFields, v.timeout_ms as timeoutMs,v.max_result_bytes as maxResultBytes, v.max_calls_per_turn as maxCallsPerTurn,v.import_format as importFormat,v.created_at as createdAt, sec.display_suffix as tokenSuffix
mapper.select: select 1 from sys_user where user_id=#{accountId} and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update
select count(*) from p_skill where status!='DELETED' and (account_id=#{accountId} or visibility='OFFICIAL')
select from p_skill s where s.status='PUBLISHED' and s.current_version_id is not null and (s.account_id=#{accountId} or s.visibility='OFFICIAL') order by s.visibility desc,s.name,s.id
select from p_skill s where s.id=#{skillId} and s.status!='DELETED' and (s.account_id=#{accountId} or s.visibility='OFFICIAL')
select from p_skill s where s.id=#{skillId} and s.account_id=#{accountId}
select from p_skill s where s.id=#{skillId} and s.account_id=#{accountId} and s.status!='DELETED' for update

select from p_skill_version v left join p_secret sec on sec.id=v.tool_secret_id where v.id=#{versionId} and (v.account_id=#{accountId} or exists (select 1 from p_skill s where s.id=v.skill_id and s.visibility='OFFICIAL'))
select from p_skill_version v left join p_secret sec on sec.id=v.tool_secret_id where v.skill_id=#{skillId} order by v.version_no desc
select coalesce(max(version_no),0)+1 from p_skill_version where skill_id=#{skillId}

select count(*) from p_skill_version v join p_skill s on s.current_version_id=v.id where s.id!=#{skillId} and (s.account_id=#{accountId} or s.visibility='OFFICIAL') and s.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and v.tool_name=#{toolName}

select (select count(*) from p_app_skill a join p_skill_version v on v.id=a.skill_version_id where v.skill_id=#{skillId}) + (select count(*) from p_resource_reference r join p_skill_version v on v.id=r.resource_id where r.resource_type='SKILL_VERSION' and r.state in ('RESERVED','CONFIRMED') and v.skill_id=#{skillId})
select request_hash as requestHash,resource_id as resourceId,status from p_api_idempotency where account_id=#{accountId} and scope=#{scope} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into p_skill_version (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,skill_id,version_no,skill_type,tool_name,instructions, context_requirements,tool_url,http_method,input_schema,output_schema,tool_secret_id, requires_user_credential,identity_binding,frontend_fields,timeout_ms,max_result_bytes, max_calls_per_turn,import_format,content_hash,created_by) values (#{id},utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{accountId},#{skillId},#{versionNo}, #{skillType},#{toolName},#{instructions},cast(#{context} as json),#{toolUrl},#{httpMethod}, cast(#{inputSchema} as json),cast(#{outputSchema} as json),#{secretId},#{userCredential}, cast(#{identityBinding} as json),cast(#{frontendFields} as json),#{timeoutMs}, #{maxResultBytes},#{maxCallsPerTurn},#{importFormat},#{hash},#{actorId})
mapper.update: update p_skill set status=#{status},revision=revision+1, deleted_at=case when #{status}='DELETED' then utc_timestamp(3) else deleted_at end, updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{skillId} and account_id=#{accountId} and revision=#{revision} and status!='DELETED'
mapper.select: select id,ciphertext,nonce,auth_tag,key_version,algorithm,status from p_secret where id=#{secretId} and account_id=#{accountId} and purpose='TOOL_ACCESS' and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update p_secret sec join p_skill_version v on v.tool_secret_id=sec.id set sec.status='DISABLED',sec.updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where v.skill_id=#{skillId} and sec.purpose='TOOL_ACCESS' and sec.status='ACTIVE'
